title: 弥生賞の後に・君にサプライズ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki stuns the audience at the Yayoi Sho, and expectations for her to claim the Classic Triple Crown rise even higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She begins training even harder than ever to meet those expectations. I'm touched by her dedication and plan a surprise to reward her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I want to give her a star, so I attempt sleight of hand to conjure a brooch shaped like the evening star… Unfortunately, my trick ends in failure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite my fumbling, Fuji Kiseki is still touched by my gesture. At last, next up for us is the Satsuki Sho.
